versions.changelog: Initial public release. Greater Stockholm map covering all 26 municipalities of Stockholms län using SCB's 2025 DeSO zones (1,362 demand points). Residential population from SCB nattbefolkning; workplace employment from SCB dagbefolkning (AM0207Z), distributed via OSM building footprints for realistic jobs/residents separation. Commuter flows from SCB RAMS OD matrix (1,191,009 commuters). Includes Stockholm Arlanda Airport as special demand (22.7M annual passengers). 701,502 buildings indexed for collision geometry.
